official_statement_rationale: The headline CPI inflation at 7.44 per cent represents a significant breach of the upper tolerance band, primarily driven by a sharp 11.51 per cent spike in food inflation. While core inflation has moderated to 4.90 per cent, indicating that demand-pull pressures remain contained, the persistence of food price shocks and the prevailing 5.0 per cent monsoon deficit necessitate a cautious approach. With GVA growth remaining resilient at 7.80 per cent and a positive output gap of 0.60 per cent, the economy has the space to absorb the current policy stance. Given the liquidity surplus of 120,000 crore INR, it is imperative that we maintain the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance to ensure that inflation expectations remain firmly anchored and that we steer inflation towards the 4.00 per cent target in a durable manner. I vote to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50 per cent and to continue with the stance of withdrawal of accommodation.
